texts.text: E-COMMERCE DEVELOPMENT

I design and develop Shopify and WooCommerce stores that make products easier to discover, compare and purchase. From storefront design and checkout to payment integrations and order management, each solution is planned around your customers and day-to-day operations.

If your store has unusual products, subscriptions, fulfilment rules or integrations, the best platform decision usually comes after understanding the operating model.
Should I use WooCommerce or Shopify?

WooCommerce is often a strong fit when you need WordPress integration, deep content flexibility, ownership and custom workflows. Shopify is often a strong fit when you prefer a managed commerce platform with lower infrastructure overhead. The right choice depends on the business model, catalogue and team.
Can you migrate an existing store to WooCommerce or Shopify?
Yes. Migration can include products, categories, customers, orders where feasible, redirects, content and the design system. The exact migration plan depends on the current platform and data quality.
Can you improve an existing store without rebuilding everything?

Yes. A redesign or optimisation project can focus on navigation, product pages, checkout, mobile usability, catalogue structure or operations without replacing the entire platform when the existing foundation is suitable.
Can you set up payments, shipping and taxes?

Yes. Payment gateways, shipping rules and tax configuration can be included in the project scope. Availability and compliance depend on the business location, customer markets and providers being used.
Do you build subscription or membership stores?
Yes. Subscription products, recurring payments, gated customer experiences and membership-style commerce can be planned where the chosen platform and payment stack support the required model.
Post-launch support can cover maintenance, bug fixes, product or catalogue changes, performance improvements, integrations and ongoing development as the store grows.
